column1: # Live RBAC route matrix: Phase 5 (sharing, write and active). Each step adds the rows of the behaviour it
# changes, in its own block; a row of an earlier file whose answer a step changes is tagged superseded-by:p5
# there. Columns: id, since, actor, method, path, body, expect, tags (see tests/rbac_matrix_live.sh).
# Step 5.5: the schedule confirmation (POST .../schedules/[scheduleId]/confirm) makes the confirmer a
# schedule's actor. recon:schedule at the Manage level (the owner until 5.2 adds Manage), same-origin
# JSON. "Allowed" is proved without a write: a body-less request passes the guard, the level and the
# origin, then gets 415; a schedule id that does not exist answers 404 after them.
